subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Explorar o espaço reservado ao leitor nos jornais, revistas, impressos e on-line, sites noticiosos etc., destacando notícias, fotorreportagens, entrevistas, charges, assuntos, temas, debates em foco, posicionando-se de maneira ética e respeitosa frente a esses textos e opiniões a eles relacionadas, e publicar notícias, notas jornalísticas, fotorreportagem de interesse geral nesses espaços do leitor.

components.description_pt: Identificar espaços de leitura em jornais, revistas e sites de notícia impressos e online
components.description_en: Identify reader spaces in print and online newspapers, magazines, and news sites

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre gêneros encontrados em espaços de leitura, como matérias, entrevistas e charges editoriais
components.description_en: Distinguish among genres found in reader spaces, such as news stories, interviews, and editorial cartoons

components.description_pt: Engajar-se com textos e opiniões publicados de maneira ética e respeitosa
components.description_en: Engage with published texts and opinions in an ethical and respectful manner
components.cc_component_description: Engage in group reading of informational texts with a stated purpose

components.description_pt: Publicar artigos de notícia, notas jornalísticas ou fotoensaios em espaços de leitura para um público geral
components.description_en: Publish news articles, journalistic notes, or photo essays in reader spaces for a general audience
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and publish written products for an intended audience

cc_matches.description: Actively engage in group reading activities with purpose and understanding.

Use technology, including the Internet, to produce, publish, and update individual or shared writing products, taking advantage of technology's capacity to link to other information and to display information flexibly and dynamically.
